$$D(d) = \sum_{k=1}^{d} 9 \cdot 10^{k-1} \cdot k$$

Using the identity $\sum_{k=1}^{n} k \cdot r^{k-1} = \frac{n \cdot r^{n+1} - (n+1) \cdot r^n + 1}{(r-1)^2}$ with $r=10$:

$$D(d) = \frac{10^d(9d-1)+1}{9}$$

**Verification:** $D(1) = \frac{10 \cdot 8 + 1}{9} = 9$ ✓; $D(2) = \frac{100 \cdot 17 + 1}{9} = 189$ ✓; $D(3) = \frac{1000 \cdot 26 + 1}{9} = 2889$ ✓.

**Check $d = 1983$:**
$$D(1983) = \frac{17846 \times 10^{1983} + 1}{9} \approx 1982.89 \times 10^{1983} = 0.1983 \times 10^{1987}$$

Since $0.1983 \times 10^{1987} < 10^{1987}$, we have $D(1983) < 10^{1987}$.

**Check $d = 1984$:**
$$D(1984) = \frac{17855 \times 10^{1984} + 1}{9} \approx 1983.89 \times 10^{1984} = 1.984 \times 10^{1987}$$

Since $1.984 \times 10^{1987} > 10^{1987}$, we have $D(1984) > 10^{1987}$.
